title: Ari Morcos: Data Quality is The Compute Multiplier

segments.text: [applause]
>> Thank you everyone. Really excited to be
here and tell you about the work we're
doing at Duality AI and why data quality
is the ultimate compute multiplier and
almost certainly the compute multiplier
that you're not thinking about.
Model ownership is becoming not just

ask at every given time point in

to value data differently than if I want

decontamination is critical for that.
